sum: Larimar Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology company, focuses on developing treatments for rare diseases using its novel cell penetrating peptide technology platform. Its lead product candidate is CTI-1601, which is in Phase 2 OLE clinical trial for the treatment of Friedreich's ataxia, a rare, progressive and fatal disease. The company is based in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania.
ceo: Dr. Carole S. Ben-Maimon M.D. (CEO & Director)
